newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends firm as interest rates soar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends firm as interest rates soar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed markedly stronger at 483.50/484.50 per dollar as benchmark six month TEM yields leapt 233 basis points to 23.86 percent in the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction, traders said.
The bolivar closed Tuesday at 485.25/486.25 per dollar.
"It was an explosive day ... the interest rate rise prompted a large inflow of foreign funds," said one trader.
A continuing liquidity squeeze in domestic financial markets further increased the attractiveness of bolivar-denominated assets, traders said.
"These days it's better to be in bolivars than dollars," said one.
Brokers said investors continued to switch into bolivars to take advantage of interbank lending rates that nudged 90 percent during the session as bolivar liquidity remained tight.
